name: IndustrialTelemetryReading
description: Represents a single time-series telemetry reading captured from an industrial asset, sensor, PLC tag, OPC UA node, or MQTT Sparkplug B metric.

reading_id.description: Unique identifier for this telemetry reading.

asset_id.description: Identifier of the asset the reading was captured from.

metric.description: Name of the metric or PLC tag.

quality.description: OPC-UA-style quality flag for the reading.

timestamp.description: Timestamp at which the value was sampled at the source.

source_protocol.description: Industrial protocol the reading was acquired through.

gateway_id.description: Identifier of the edge gateway that ingested the reading.

namespace.description: Logical namespace for the metric, often the unified-namespace path.
